243 errors out of 1000 spans — 24.3% error rate. Widespread auth failures likely blocking downstream request processing.

recommended_action: Immediately circuit-break the RAG pipeline: throttle tool-executor and llm-gemini ingress to halt cascading failures. Investigate postgres-auth for DB degradation (high auth error rate). Reduce RAG retrieval chunk sizes to address token truncations. Scale or restart api-gateway pods to clear the 64% error rate at ingress. Enable payments-service bulkhead isolation to prevent further cascade into the payments DB.
summary: A confirmed rag_meltdown scenario is in full effect, driving a system-wide 25.6% error rate and a p99 latency of ~26.4 seconds. The api-gateway (64% errors), tool-executor (47% errors, 233 tool failures), and agent-service (42% errors) are the most critically impacted, with LLM token truncations (34 events) and auth/payments DB degradation compounding the failure cascade across the entire stack.
